title: Two Late Call-Ups: How the US Rebuilt Its Billie Jean King Cup Lineup
text:
Krueger and Krawczyk Join US BJK Cup Team

 Ashlyn Krueger and Desirae Krawczyk replace injured Keys Keys in US Billie Jean King Cup team for Hungary tie 
 Billie Jean King Cup Ashlyn Krueger and Desirae Krawczyk replace injured Keys Keys in US Billie Jean King Cup team for Hungary tie 
 Jim Flannigan | 18 November 2026 | 3 min read Ashlyn Krueger - Photo: IMAGO / NurPhoto Share this article
 Add us as a preferred source on Google 
 Ashlyn Krueger and Desirae Krawczyk have joined the US Billie Jean King Cup team for this weekend’s playoff against Hungary in Delray Beach after Madison Keys and Nicole Melichar-Martinez withdrew. The tie decides whether the 18-time champions can compete for the 2027 title.
 World singles No. 41 Krueger and world doubles No. 27 Krawczyk join Coco Gauff, Ann Li and Taylor Townsend for the tie against Hungary on 21 and 22 November at the Delray Beach Tennis Center, with Lindsay Davenport as captain.
 The best-of-five contest is played over two days, and the first nation to win three matches goes through. The winner returns to the Qualifying pool with a shot at the 2027 crown, while the loser drops to a Regional Group I event next year. Play starts at 1.30 p.m. ET on both days. Both newcomers were confirmed less than a week before the opening rubbers.
 Serious knee injury rules out Melichar-Martinez
 Melichar-Martinez hurt her knee while playing a volley during her final group match at the WTA Finals. A scan later showed a complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament plus additional damage, and she now faces a long spell away from the tour. The 33-year-old was ranked No. 9 in doubles when the squad was named and played for the US in Belgium earlier this year.
 Keys has not played since the US Open, where she lost in the third round to Zheng Qinwen after leading 5-0 in the deciding set. She later withdrew from the China Open, and the USTA did not give a reason for her absence from this tie.
 Their replacements bring useful experience. Krawczyk is a four-time Grand Slam mixed doubles champion who played for the US in Qualifying in 2025 and against Ukraine in 2022. Krueger has stepped in at short notice before, replacing Jessica Pegula at the 2024 Finals in Malaga.
 Gauff leads the US on familiar ground
 Gauff, a Delray Beach native and two-time Grand Slam singles champion, remains the headline name. Townsend, a four-time Grand Slam doubles champion, and Li give Davenport depth in both singles and doubles. Li was ranked No. 25 in singles when the squad was first named. Hungary has nominated Ana Bondar, Dalma Galfi, Amarissa Toth, Fanny Stollar and Adrienn Nagy under captain Kornel Bardoczky. Bondar, ranked No. 75 at the time of nomination, is the highest-ranked singles player in the visiting team.
 The venue should help the hosts. The US is unbeaten in four Billie Jean King Cup ties at the Delray Beach Tennis Center, most recently sweeping Austria in 2023 with Gauff and Pegula leading the way.
 The Americans are in the playoff after a 3-1 defeat to Belgium in April’s qualifiers. That setback came only months after Davenport guided the team to the 2025 final, which they lost to Italy. The US holds a record 18 titles but has not won the competition since 2017, so avoiding a drop to regional play is the first step back.
